sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Settings template
sections.what: Lists the settings lines, grouped by topic: database, AI service, API, frontend and research cache.
sections.why: Likely reason: documents every setting in one place for a new user.
sections.watch_out: Real secrets must go in a private file that is not shared, not in this example.

summary: A template listing the settings the app reads from its environment, with example values to copy.
purpose: Show what to set up so the database, the AI service, the API and the research cache can run.
why: Likely reason: a common pattern so a new user can copy it to a real settings file and change the values.
how: Copy the file to a real environment file, change the values, and the app reads them at startup. It covers the database address, the Ollama address, an optional Redis address, the API host, port and reload setting, the frontend address, and the research cache folder and expiry.
outputs: Settings the app uses while running.
risks: Contains example credentials such as admin and password, which must not be used in a real setup. Reload is on, which is meant for development. The expiry line has a comment after the value, which some tools may read as part of the number.
debug: If the app cannot reach the database, check the database line. If the expiry setting fails to load, remove the trailing comment. Whether Redis is used anywhere cannot be seen from this file.
